events.title: Welcome Back Get-Together!
events.description:
The Hudson County Youth Leadership
Council invites you to join us to kick off a
new school year with an afternoon of fun,
food, friends and community! Come and
enjoy games and activities, arts and crafts,
music and entertainment, giveaways,
community resources, and refreshments.

events.title: Comprehensive Plan Open House
events.description:
The 2050 Comprehensive Plan will communicate a shared vision for Hudson County’s future!
Join Hudson County’s Division of Planning at one of our three Open House events. Share your ideas with us while we present information about the Plan, our current research, and some of our draft goals for 2050
